name: fox
concept: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst gouache prompt in ref/prompt.txt, start frames via `reel light start` (start.png at the left for the idle, start_center.png --left 0.42 for the walk). Takes: H3 768P 16:9, firstFrameImage only. Idle: takes/h3_idle.json (loop 0..108: frame 110 matches 0). Walk: walking IN PLACE (takes/h3_walk_place.json), 32-frame stride 53..84 (84 matches 52), speed from the planted foot; 3 earlier walk-across takes all cut to a new framing at frames 12-20 and drifted the backdrop to black/cyan. The in-place take bobs the whole body ~16 px (feet included): walk uses "ground": "lowest" (smoothed lowest foot). Known: a ~11 px foot slip at walk frame 22->23 (filmed 75->76).
